HOW TO PLAY

🎰 THE BASICS

Pull the lever to spin the reels. Every spin lands you on a challenge tile — a dare, a social task, a drink, or a gamble. Complete it to earn XP and coins. Keep crawling, level up, and grow your brewery.

🪙 HOW YOU MAKE MONEY

Two streams: coins from completed tiles (paid out win or lose) and the brewery, which drips beer coins passively every minute. Level up and buy relics to increase your brew rate — the animated brewery at the top shows your current output.

💎 RELICS & ITEMS

Relics are permanent buffs from the shop — they last the whole crawl and boost brewery rate. Items are one-use consumables — tap USE in the bag when ready. Some are hidden until you trigger them naturally.

🔁 REROLLS

Not happy with a tile? Spend a reroll to skip it and spin again. Your reroll count is in the BAG tab. Out of rerolls? Empty your beer and you get a new roll anyway.

🎯 BOUNTIES & UNDERDOGS

From the third bar, every NEW BAR starts with phones up. The highest level gets a price on their head: challenge them head-to-head (a duel tile, a Holmgang, or best-of-3 rock paper scissors). You get one shot per bar: win and tap I WON for a chunk of XP; lose and tap I LOST, pay 20 coins and take a forfeit. Every hunter the bounty beats pays them coins and grows their prize. If nobody gets them before the next bar, the bounty pockets XP and coins, and the price grows if they're still on top. The lowest level becomes the Underdog: +30% XP on every tile they win that bar, plus a free reroll.

🏆 BOSS TILES

High-stakes challenges with big XP. Lose one and it marks you for revenge — beat it later for +50% XP. Winning a boss also opens the shop.

💾 YOUR PROGRESS

Saves automatically every action. To back up your run against browser storage wipes, copy the code below.
